observation.visible_scene: A paved cycle path runs between a stone retaining wall topped by a chain-link fence and houses on a slope to the left, and a green grassy bank lined with pink-blossomed trees to the right, under a blue sky. A cyclist wearing a bright pink top rides away from the viewpoint on a bicycle fitted with a rear basket holding a light-colored bag. The viewpoint travels forward along the path behind the cyclist.
visible_changes: The camera moves steadily forward along the path, so the row of pink trees on the right and the houses/wall on the left slide past and shift in perspective (parallax).
The cyclist grows larger in the frame from first to last view, indicating the camera is closing the distance to the rider rather than the rider moving away.
The cyclist remains roughly centered on the path, in a riding posture, continuing forward throughout the excerpt.
The white house at the upper left in early frames moves out of view as the camera advances, while the pink house on the left becomes more prominent.
outside_clip_unknowns: What happens before the first frame and after the last frame (the ride continues beyond this segment).
The exact speed of the cyclist and of the camera, and whether either is accelerating.
The contents of the basket and the cyclist's identity are not fully resolvable.
uncertain_details: The cyclist's pedaling motion is not clearly resolved frame-to-frame; only the overall forward posture is supported.
It is uncertain whether the apparent approach is due to camera speed exceeding the cyclist's speed or a change in cyclist speed; only the decreasing gap is visible.
